Apresenta um plano a quem usa e espera a: Presents a plan to the person and waits for the decision. In Plan mode, use it when the plan is ready: the person chooses to execute (and with which permission) or to keep planning, and if they approve you go on executing in the same reply. In the other modes, use it before starting a big task (several files, a change of structure, something hard to undo, or when there is more than one reasonable path): the person answers go ahead, asks for a change or says not to do it. A small, clear task goes straight ahead, with no plan.
Faz de 1 a 4 perguntas a quem usa num ca: Asks the person 1 to 4 questions on a card with options to click (and a field to write another answer), and waits. Use it only when you are stuck on a decision that belongs to the person and can't be settled from the request, the files or a sensible default. Put the option you recommend first, with "(recommended)" at the end of its label. Don't ask what you can assume, don't ask whether you may go on (that is what the plan is for) and don't repeat the questions in the text.
